We've got the heavy-recovery driving block from 0900 to 1100 and the light-vehicle handling block from 0800 to 1000. I need to confirm we still have a qualified instructor for the heavy-recovery block and a serviceable training vehicle for the light-vehicle block. Sgt. Vale and Cpl. Ortiz are currently listed as available instructors, and TR-21 and TR-22 are listed as available vehicles. Are there any changes or issues I need to know about before I lock in the schedule?
